title: Samsung DDR5-4800 ECC RDIMM — 4× 32 GB
caption: Four Samsung DDR5 ECC RDIMMs on dark surface
prompt: Create a photorealistic 3D render of four Samsung DDR5-4800 ECC RDIMM modules arranged in a neat row on a neutral dark gray surface, as seen in technical product photography. Each module should be a standard server DIMM form factor, measuring approximately 133mm long by 30mm tall. The modules feature a green PCB with no heatspreader, exposing multiple evenly spaced black DRAM chip packages on both sides of each stick. In the center of each module, include a realistic Samsung label sticker as found on genuine server RAM, but avoid any extraneous text overlays. The gold edge connector pins should be clearly visible along the bottom edge of each module, reflecting the light subtly. Arrange the four modules parallel to each other with a slight, even spacing, resembling cards fanned out in a hand, but all aligned in the same direction. Use soft, diffuse studio lighting to highlight the textures of the PCB, chips, and gold contacts, with gentle reflections and shadows for depth. The background should be a clean, featureless dark gray, emphasizing the technical and professional aesthetic. The image should be in a landscape (3:2) aspect ratio, focusing entirely on the RAM modules with no people or conceptual elements—just the physical components as they would appear in a vendor datasheet or product page.
